subject: [RFC PATCH 08/18] mm/memory-failure: handle folios with PG_rcu_free

2026-10-19.patch_summary: This patch addresses an issue where memory_failure() and soft_offline_page() cannot handle pages that are waiting for an RCU (Read-Copy-Update) grace period, which can lead to a poisoned page being handed out again. The patch introduces a new function mf_free_rcu_pages() that frees these waiting pages before handling the memory failure. It also ensures that the caller waits for a grace period after setting PG_hwpoison on the page to prevent readers from accessing the poisoned page. This approach prevents errors and ensures data integrity.
